lines.zh: 我翅上是橙色，边上一圈黑。
lines.en: My wings are orange with a black border.

lines.zh: 晨光一照，翅面像烧起来。
lines.en: In the morning light my wings look aflame.
I fly low, close to the flower heads.
The jungle mist has not cleared.
I circle the same tree.
My wingtip skims the water.
This much damp is just right.
I rest on a stalk of grass.
A clump of orange flowers lies ahead.
I fly a stretch toward them.
Droplets sway on the leaf edge.
I fly slowly to see the path.
Light falls through the leaves.
I settle in the middle of the patch.
This hour has the most butterflies.
I dodge a bird in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我停在草茎上，翅还摊着。
lines.en: I rest on the stalk with wings still spread.
The orange goes dark in the shade.
The mist clears and the wood brightens.
I quiver my wing edge.
A bee circles in.
I move a little away.
Something is already on the flower.
I wait for it to leave.
The orange slowly starts to glow.
The stalk is thin; one move and it bends.

lines.zh: 太阳升高前，我不急着飞。
lines.en: I do not hurry to fly before the sun rises.

lines.zh: 翅上的橙色是给同类看的。
lines.en: The orange is a signal to my own kind.
There is an orange flower in your hand.
It is the same colour as my wings.
You are holding it very near.
I can hardly tell them apart.
Your breath moves the petals.

lines.zh: 你把手掌摊得像一片叶。
lines.en: You hold your palm out like a leaf.
I dare not land on it.

lines.zh: 你的手指上有一点橙色。
lines.en: There is a fleck of orange on your finger.
Pollen, I think.
You hold the flower farther away.
A tear runs through the orange.
I drop onto the grass.
The wing edge curls and I cannot fly true.
Dust falls at my feet.
A rest and I can fly again.
The crack reaches the wing base.
I fold my wings in tight.
Wind leaks through the tear.
I fly very low this time.
The orange part is the most fragile.
That flower was just picked.
The nectar is still in it.
Lower your hand a little.
I settle at the petal's edge.
Just do not move.
That sip is very sweet.

lines.zh: 你摘的那朵上还有露水。
lines.en: There is still dew on the one you picked.
I drink twice in a row.
The dew is cooler than nectar.
Let me have a little more.
You hit the stalk and I sway.
I hold on and do not fall.
Your shadow covers me.
The orange on my wings goes dim.
I wait for you to move.
Then I am bright again.
I retreat to another flower.
Now neither of us touches the other.
Your cuff brushes the petals.
The petals sway once.

lines.zh: 清晨飞的那只我没追上。
lines.en: I did not catch the one that flew at dawn.
Its wings were paler than mine.
The wind is light today; good.
I am waiting on the flowers.
Its black border is wider than mine.
I am waiting for it to return.
It will only fly once the sun is higher.
It is too cool just yet.
It is on those low trees.
I will fly over to find it.
Something is caught on the grass.
Orange, but not a flower.
I brush it with a leg twice.
I cannot shift it.
It is far too heavy.
Let it hang there.
I ask, and no one answers.
That is not a petal.
I leave it on the grass.
The wind will carry it off.
Your net reaches into the flowers.
You cannot tell the orange apart either.
I change flowers while I can.
You moved the net to your left hand.
I see it perfectly now.
I slip down the flower's stem.
You stand upwind.
I cannot smell you.
So I must rely on my eyes.
I have marked where you stand.
You are still standing at the patch's edge.
I move one bloom deeper.
And you move too.
So I stop moving.
You are always half a step behind.
I wait for you on this bloom.
Reach out and I lift off.
You changed your footing.
Your shadow shifted half a foot.
I shrink back into the flowers.
You pinch the base of my wing.
That is the thinnest part.
I push at your fingertip with my legs.
Your fingertips are all orange dust.
That colour will not wash out.
I pull free with half a wing.
Your fingers squeeze very lightly.
It hurts me a great deal.

lines.zh: 你松手的时候我掉了一下。
lines.en: When you let go I dropped.
A mark stays on my wing.
I only come out when the mist clears.
Water still clings to my wings.
The first ray of light comes down.
I spread my wings to dry.
This patch has only just bloomed.
The orange one stands out most.

lines.zh: 叶子上的水滑得站不住。
lines.en: The water on the leaf makes it slick.
I grip that leaf vein.
My wings open a little at a time.
The orange spreads across them.

lines.zh: 一阵热风过去，翅边卷成褐色。
lines.en: A wave of heat passes and the wing edge curls brown.

lines.zh: 我从草尖翻下去，落在泥上。
lines.en: I tumble off the grass onto the mud.
Water grips my wings; I paddle hard.
The blast sweeps me into the brush.

lines.zh: 一颗石子擦掉我一片翅。
lines.en: A pebble shaves off a piece of my wing.

lines.zh: 光一过，翅上的橙就淡了。
lines.en: The light passes and the orange pales.

lines.zh: 花都被摘光了，我飞不远。
lines.en: The flowers are all picked; I cannot fly far.

lines.zh: 那道光让我一头栽下去。
lines.en: The flash drops me out of the air.

lines.zh: 橙翅下只剩虚空，我在掉
lines.en: Only the void under my orange wings; I am falling.
